messages:
rashid: FYI incoming via support — Acme Health submitted a security/compliance intake. Attached questionnaire + asks. Key points: SOC2 questionnaire, HIPAA/BAA discussion, per-tenant audit logs with configurable retention, exportable logs for audits, data residency + deletion API. They want compliance milestones in contract. Case: SUP-8412. Link to QNA: https://drive.example.com/acrohealth-qna.xlsx

anya: Thanks — can you paste the top-level asks here and the deadline? Also we need to decide whether this is a product backlog item or a sales/ops doc. @jordyn can you advise on HIPAA blockers for hosted?

rashid: Top-level asks copied from the questionnaire: 1) Completed SOC2 control responses and evidence 2) Signed BAA for PHI 3) Per-tenant audit logs, exportable in machine-readable format 4) Retention policy configurable per-tenant (30/90/365/forever) + certified deletion proof 5) Data residency options (EU/US)
They indicated they want compliance commitments by EOY but will push contract if we can commit to a Q2 milestone.

jordyn: High level: SOC2 artifacts + control evidence we can supply for hosted (control mappings, logs, monitoring screenshots). HIPAA is trickier — we should require Dedicated or Private for PHI workloads unless legal approves hosted with strict controls. Audit logs + retention are feasible but will need infra work (storage, retention lifecycle) and an export API. Also need to capture requestor IP, model_id, and timestamps for forensics.

celeste: From legal: we can produce a BAA template but will require 2–3 weeks to review and a few clarifications on what counts as proof of deletion. Don't promise specific timelines until infra scope is known. If we push for hosted PHI support, we need a formal risk assessment.

mike: Customer is large ARR and this is a near-term procurement blocker. They asked whether hosted can be used to reduce cost. If we propose Dedicated as the path for HIPAA, they'll want pricing and lead times.

anya: Proposal: split into two workstreams to avoid blocking the sale —
- Track A (P0): SOC2 questionnaire + provide hosted control evidence + basic audit export (help close the contract negotiation)
- Track B (P1): HIPAA readiness (BAA + per-tenant logs + retention UI/API + Dedicated/private deployment guidance). Will require infra and legal sign-off.
We need acceptance criteria for Track A to put in the backlog.

rashid: Draft acceptance criteria for backlog (feel free to edit):
```
- SOC2: Completed questionnaire answers uploaded to docs + mapping to internal controls; sample audit evidence links; statement of applicable SLA controls.
- Audit logs: Admin API endpoint to export tenant audit logs in NDJSON with fields [timestamp, actor_id, actor_ip, action, model_id, prompt_id]; sample export for last 30 days.
- Data retention: Admin API to set retention window per tenant (30/90/365/forever) and backend lifecycle that deletes data when TTL expires; provide deletion proof (exportable deletion manifest).
- BAA: Legal-approved BAA template uploaded to contract library.
```

jordyn: Rough engineering estimates (ballpark):
- SOC2 questionnaire + docs: 3 dev days + 2 techwrite days
- Audit export NDJSON endpoint: 8 dev days + 3 infra days (storage + retention lifecycle)
- Per-tenant retention UI + API: 12 dev days + 5 infra days (retention enforcement, deletion proofs)
Dependencies: infra retention, SRE policy for logs, Dedicated infra for HIPAA isolation.

celeste: Legal estimate: 2–3 weeks for BAA template and review of deletion proof process. Also need to confirm whether exportable deletion manifests meet customer audit needs.

anya: Action items: create product backlog ticket with acceptance criteria, attach the questionnaire, and assign owners. Recommendation: prioritize SOC2 artifacts & a minimal audit export for hosted as P0 to avoid losing the deal; push HIPAA full readiness as P1 tied to Dedicated offering.

mike: +1. I'll tell Acme we can deliver SOC2 artifacts in ~3 weeks and can scope export timelines. If they insist on HIPAA sooner, we will propose Dedicated with a separate project plan. :thumbsup:

rashid: Created PROD-1876 and linked SUP-8412 with the questionnaire. Files uploaded here: https://drive.example.com/acrohealth-qna.xlsx. Owner assignments added in PROD-1876. :eyes:

anya: Thanks — scheduling a follow-up sync for scope confirmation Wed 10am. @oncall-bot set reminder please.

oncall-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-25 10:00 (UTC) by oncall-bot.

jordyn: One more technical note — ensure audit logs include requester IP, model_id, and materialized prompt_id for reproducibility. Add that to PROD-1876 acceptance criteria.

celeste: Also add GDPR data subject request process for EU customers (export + deletion) to the acceptance criteria if they're in scope.

anya: Updated acceptance criteria in PROD-1876 to reflect IP/model/prompt fields and GDPR DSR flow. Closing thread for now; we'll reconvene after the Wednesday sync. :white_check_mark:
